unit.why: A short anecdote told by R. Leibele Eiger about meeting the holy man of Mogielnica in Lublin, followed by a non-narrative list of the master's great disciples with brief praises.
unit.boundary_note: the anecdote is followed by a list of disciples (non-narrative appendix, praise sayings)

stories.start_quote: סיפר אחד מחסידי הצדיק ר׳ ליבלי א״ר
stories.summary_en: R. Leibele Eiger tells how the tzaddik of Mogielnica, visiting Lublin, singled him out among the crowd greeting him in the beit midrash and asked who he was; Leibele slipped away unnamed, later calling the Mogielnica rebbe unique in his generation and saying he would have travelled to him had he lived.

quotes: סיפר אחד מחסידי הצדיק ר׳ ליבלי א״ר
tags.why: the tale is framed as told by a hasid, who heard it from R. Leibele
